It feels like if you need an appointment or even a simple sick note, you must know someone inside the system, otherwise it is almost impossible to be seen. My wife was treated very poorly by this practice. Because her condition was not taken seriously and she did not receive proper care in time, her health became much worse and she is now bed bound.
Unfortunately, I personally experienced the same attitude when I was there. After seeing how my wife was treated and the difficulty in getting proper medical attention, I have lost all confidence in this GP practice.
I will also be lodging a formal complaint with the relevant department about this matter. Patients deserve to be treated with respect and to receive timely medical care. I was previously under the care of Blackfriars Medical Practice in Salford, where I felt genuinely supported and looked after. My treatment plan was stable, carefully managed, and most importantly — it was working. I never had any issues and always felt safe and heard.

Everything changed when I had to move to Oldham due to my disabilities and the need for support from my family. I registered with Chowdhury Medical Practice, and from the very beginning, the experience has been nothing short of devastating.

The doctors there completely overturned my established medication plan with no proper discussion or understanding of my condition. Without warning, my repeat prescriptions were changed from monthly to weekly — despite my mobility issues and the fact that I physically struggle to get to the pharmacy so often. It felt like no one cared about how this would affect me.

What hurt me the most was when Dr. Hussain falsely wrote in my medical records that I had a history of overdosing — something that has never happened. Although he later admitted the mistake and added a note, the damage was already done. That false accusation still sits in my record, and now every new GP I see is greeted with a lie that questions my character and integrity. It has left me feeling ashamed, even though I have done nothing wrong.

The attitude of the staff was cold, dismissive, and at times outright hostile. I felt like a burden — like I wasn’t worth their time or care. They showed no empathy, no willingness to listen, and certainly no respect for the treatment plan that had helped me for years.

This experience broke me. I felt helpless, humiliated, and completely alone. I have since deregistered and moved to another practice, but the emotional and practical impact of what happened at Chowdhury Medical Practice is still with me. I’m now left hoping that other doctors won’t judge me based on one GP’s careless, inaccurate words.

This practice turned a safe and stable medical journey into one filled with anxiety, fear, and deep sadness. I would not wish this experience on anyone.

DO NOT REGISTER WITH THEM.",null,[0,122]]]],[null,1748601377000000,1748601377000000,"9 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/9944383036163895447/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZiMW95T1VSM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9944383036163895447/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZiMW95T1VSM0VBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/9944383036163895447/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZiMW95T1VSM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9944383036163895447/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZiMW95T1VSM0VBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/9944383036163895447/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZiMW95T1VSM0VBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/9944383036163895447/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVUnZiMW95T1VSM0VBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Please can you contact the surgery to discuss this and ask for the practice manager.
